notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE!
notes.notes:
The time is finally here to release multiplayer mode to the public!
Please be patient with us as we work to get all features from single player working in multiplayer.

Right now, friends can explore the massive world and work together to create a base and fend off monsters. 

You can partner up with a max of 4 friends or randoms using the multiplayer room finder.

As well as multiplayer, we have released a few more new updates!

+added cheats to singleplayer
+removed mystery button replaced with coin button
+make so need 1 glass instead of sand to make window
+added bomb throwing using Q and E keys and ammo replenish in singleplayer
+bombs make enemies stunned for a short time in order to grab loot safely
+added harvest tile effect
+made so its esc and tab to open menu now
+added dialogue about bomb throwing on talking starter guy
+added controls panel to options

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Our first update has arrived!!!!
 We decided to push back the multiplayer update a bit further...
We are still working to get all features available in multiplayer.

Here is what's NEW!
- Added a clock and time to tell time of day
- Time of day is now save and loadable
- Name of crafting item is now shown in crafting panel
- Adjusted rain settings
- Added new talkable NPC orc in the world
- Added new unlockable characters
- Created a character shop
- Added a craftable spawn point you can place in your home

notes.title: Tomorrow IS the BIG DAY!
notes.notes:
Tomorrow is the big day! We will be releasing to the public at 12pm EST US!

Get ready to salvage and travel your way thru a post-apocalyptic world where exploration is endless...

GET CREATIVE! Build a doomsday shelter, a tree top mansion, or a large village. 

SHOW OFF YOUR CREATIONS IN THE COMMUNITY SECTION!!!
BEST BUILD GETS A PRIZE!!!!!! Winners called at the end of every month.

See you, Survivors!

notes.title: SANDBOX SURVIVORS COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
In this 2D survival RPG set in a post-apocalyptic landscape, players must gather materials, construct a safe haven, and fend off the monstrous threats that roam the earth. With a robust crafting system, you can create a variety of tiles, allowing you to reshape the world around you to reflect your vision. As you embark on thrilling quests and aid fellow survivors, you’ll gain recognition and wealth, paving your way to building the base of your dreams...

We are excited to announce the grand launch of Sandbox Survivors coming to store for a low price of 4.99 USD! 

We plan on launching on Google Play Store for mobile gamers with cross-platform features.

We have plans of adding a multiplayer mode for players in our next update.

Put SANDBOX SURVIVORS on your WISHLIST !!!! 

...dive into endless exploration and unleash your creativity in a game where survival is just the beginning.
